---
title: "Publications"
---

This list updates itself every week from the PI's [ORCID record](https://orcid.org/0000-0002-8437-2180) and [OpenAlex](https://openalex.org). The PI's name is in **bold**.

{{< include _publications.md >}}

```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  const box = document.getElementById("pub-search");
  if (!box) return;
  box.addEventListener("input", function () {
    const q = box.value.trim().toLowerCase();
    document.querySelectorAll(".pub-year").forEach(function (sec) {
      let shown = 0;
      const yearHit = q && sec.dataset.year.toLowerCase().includes(q);
      sec.querySelectorAll("li.pub").forEach(function (li) {
        const hit = !q || yearHit || li.textContent.toLowerCase().includes(q);
        li.style.display = hit ? "" : "none";
        if (hit) shown++;
      });
      sec.style.display = shown ? "" : "none";
    });
  });
})();
</script>
```
